project_type: WordPress Elementor Widget Plugin (PHP with inline CSS/JS)
build_system: No build system - PHP files are loaded directly by WordPress/Elementor
verification_instructions: Run php -l on all widget PHP files to verify no syntax errors. The plugin has no unit tests - validation is PHP lint only.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - PHP files are standalone widget classes
environment_constraints: No WordPress/Elementor runtime available for functional testing. Validate PHP syntax only with php -l.
contribution_requirements: All CSS and JS is inline in each widget's render() method. Each widget uses a unique ID prefix to avoid style collisions. RTL (direction:rtl) is mandatory. Font family is Vazirmatn/IRANSans/Tahoma.
key_patterns: Each widget extends \Elementor\Widget_Base, uses Vira_Sections_Preset_Trait, has register_controls() for Elementor panel and render() for frontend output. CSS uses custom properties (--vira-*) scoped to #unique-id. JS is wrapped in an IIFE. All text is RTL Persian.
directory_structure: vira-sections-plugin/ is the plugin root. widgets/ contains all 12 widget PHP files. assets/css/ has editor.css and frontend.css. includes/ has class-leads.php, class-presets.php, trait-preset-controls.php. docs/ has INSTALLATION.md.
